summary: Pretty serialization marked every table implicit, causing empty tables to disappear: serializing "[example]\n" produced an empty string. The fix marks only nonempty tables implicit, preserving meaningful empty table headers. The fix-added regression test is pretty_empty_table in tests/pretty.rs and requires the easy feature. Both reversal regions occur exactly once; replacing the fixed region restores the exact parent implementation file. No tests were run.
expected_failure: pretty_empty_table: equality assertion fails because the expected string is "[example]\n" but the serialized result is "".
